name: Software Developer
description: Designs, builds, tests, and maintains software such as websites, mobile apps, APIs, and business systems. Uses programming, data structures, version control, and problem-solving to turn requirements into reliable products.
education: Computer Science or related degree; skills-based routes possible

name: Data Analyst
description: Turns raw data into useful findings for business or operational decisions. Cleans datasets, queries databases, applies statistics, and builds charts or dashboards to explain patterns and trends.
education: Any bachelor's degree with quantitative or analytical preparation

name: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Helps protect an organisation’s systems, networks, and information from attacks. Monitors security alerts, investigates suspicious activity, checks vulnerabilities, and supports incident response and security controls.
education: Computer Science, IT, or cybersecurity training

name: UX/UI Designer
description: Designs digital products that are useful, accessible, and easy to navigate. Researches user needs, maps journeys, creates wireframes and prototypes, and tests interface designs before development.
education: Design, psychology, human-computer interaction, or portfolio-based route

name: Graphic Designer
description: Creates visual materials that communicate a message or identity, including branding, posters, social media graphics, and layouts. Uses typography, colour, composition, and design software to meet a brief.
education: Design degree, diploma, or strong portfolio

name: Teacher / Educator
description: Plans and delivers lessons, explains subject concepts, assesses learning, and adapts teaching to students’ needs. Creates a supportive classroom and tracks progress toward learning goals.
education: Relevant subject degree and required teaching qualification

name: School Counselor
description: Supports students with academic, social, emotional, and career-related concerns within the counselor’s professional scope. Listens carefully, helps students identify options, maintains appropriate records, and refers cases when specialist care is needed.
education: Psychology or counseling education plus required credentials

name: Clinical Psychologist
description: Assesses and helps treat psychological and mental-health difficulties using evidence-based methods within their licensed scope. May conduct evaluations, provide therapy, document progress, and contribute to research or multidisciplinary care.
education: Psychology degrees and licensing/registration as required locally

name: Social Worker
description: Helps individuals, families, and communities access services and respond to social challenges. Assesses needs, coordinates support, advocates for clients, documents cases, and works with community organisations.
education: Social work degree or locally accepted qualification

name: Doctor / Physician
description: Diagnoses, treats, and helps prevent illness and injury. Takes patient histories, examines patients, interprets tests, recommends treatment, explains options, and coordinates care while following medical ethics and licensing rules.
education: Medical degree and required licensing

name: Nurse
description: Provides and coordinates patient care in hospitals, clinics, community settings, or other healthcare services. Monitors health, administers care within their scope, records observations, educates patients, and collaborates with the clinical team.
education: Recognized nursing qualification and registration

name: Physiotherapist
description: Assesses movement and physical function and helps people recover or manage mobility, pain, and activity limitations. Designs and monitors exercise-based rehabilitation plans and teaches safe movement strategies.
education: Recognized physiotherapy qualification and registration

name: Nutritionist / Dietitian
description: Uses nutrition knowledge to support health, dietary needs, and food-related goals. Assesses eating patterns, develops appropriate nutrition guidance, monitors progress, and adapts advice to evidence and professional scope.
education: Nutrition or dietetics education; credential requirements vary

name: Pharmacist
description: Supports the safe and effective use of medicines. Reviews prescriptions, checks doses and interactions, advises patients on medicine use, maintains records, and follows pharmacy regulations and patient-safety procedures.
education: Recognized pharmacy qualification and registration

name: Public Health Professional
description: Works to improve health across communities rather than only treating individual patients. Uses health data and research to plan prevention programmes, evaluate interventions, communicate risks, and address population-level health needs.
education: Public health, health sciences, or related education

name: Lawyer / Advocate
description: Advises or represents clients on legal matters within their authorised practice area. Researches legislation and cases, prepares legal documents, develops arguments, negotiates where appropriate, and follows professional and ethical obligations.
education: Law degree and required bar enrollment/licensing

name: Legal Researcher
description: Finds, interprets, and organises legal information to support lawyers, courts, policy teams, or researchers. Reviews statutes and judgments, checks authorities, prepares accurate summaries, and cites sources consistently.
education: Law degree or relevant legal research training

name: Journalist / Reporter
description: Researches and reports news or public-interest stories for print, broadcast, or digital audiences. Interviews sources, verifies claims, checks context, writes or records reports, and follows editorial and ethical standards.
education: Journalism, communications, or strong reporting portfolio

name: Content Writer / Editor
description: Creates, reviews, and improves written material for a specific audience and purpose. Researches topics, structures information, checks accuracy and grammar, edits drafts, and adapts tone for articles, websites, or other content.
education: Any relevant education; writing portfolio is important

name: Translator / Interpreter
description: Transfers meaning between languages while preserving accuracy, context, and cultural nuance. Translators work mainly with written material; interpreters convey spoken or signed communication in real time or scheduled settings.
education: Language proficiency and relevant training or credentials

name: Public Relations Specialist
description: Manages how an organisation communicates with the public, media, and stakeholders. Writes announcements, coordinates media responses, prepares messaging, tracks public sentiment, and supports communication during sensitive situations.
education: Communications, journalism, marketing, or related education

name: Marketing Specialist
description: Plans and supports campaigns that help an organisation reach customers and communicate product value. Researches audiences, develops messaging, coordinates channels, tracks campaign performance, and uses results to improve marketing activity.
education: Marketing, business, communications, or related education

name: Market Research Analyst
description: Studies customers, competitors, and market conditions to help organisations make decisions. Designs or analyses surveys, interprets quantitative and qualitative findings, identifies trends, and presents evidence-based recommendations.
education: Business, economics, psychology, statistics, or related education

name: Human Resources Specialist
description: Supports employee-related processes such as recruitment, onboarding, workplace policies, records, and employee relations. Handles sensitive information carefully and helps ensure people practices are consistent with organisational policies and applicable rules.
education: Human resources, business, psychology, or related education

name: Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Finds and evaluates candidates for open roles and coordinates the hiring process. Sources applicants, reviews qualifications, conducts or schedules interviews, communicates with candidates, and works with hiring managers to assess role fit.
education: Any relevant bachelor's degree; hiring experience helps

name: Entrepreneur / Small Business Owner
description: Builds and operates a business by identifying a customer need, testing an offer, managing costs, and developing sales. Handles planning, customer research, budgeting, operations, and risk while meeting relevant legal requirements.
education: No single required degree; depends on the business and regulations

name: Business Analyst
description: Connects business needs with practical process or technology improvements. Gathers stakeholder requirements, maps current workflows, analyses problems, documents proposed changes, and helps teams validate whether a solution meets the need.
education: Business, economics, information systems, or related education

name: Accountant
description: Maintains and reviews financial records so organisations can understand transactions and meet reporting obligations. Reconciles accounts, prepares statements, supports tax or audit work, and applies accounting standards and ethical practices.
education: Accounting, commerce, or finance education; credentials may help

name: Financial Analyst
description: Evaluates financial information to support planning, investment, budgeting, or business decisions. Builds spreadsheets and forecasts, analyses performance and risks, compares scenarios, and communicates findings in reports.
education: Finance, economics, accounting, mathematics, or related education

name: Actuary
description: Uses mathematics, statistics, and financial theory to estimate uncertainty and risk, often in insurance, pensions, or finance. Builds and validates models, interprets data, and communicates the implications of risk estimates; professional exams are commonly required.
education: Mathematics, statistics, or actuarial education plus professional exams

name: Banking Relationship Manager
description: Builds and maintains relationships with banking customers and helps them understand suitable financial products and services. Assesses customer needs, explains options, supports account or lending processes, and follows compliance requirements.
education: Finance, commerce, business, or related education

name: Civil Engineer
description: Plans, designs, assesses, or oversees infrastructure such as roads, bridges, buildings, water systems, and transport networks. Applies engineering calculations, drawings, project coordination, codes, and safety practices.
education: Recognized civil engineering degree and required licensing where applicable

name: Architect
description: Develops building designs that respond to client needs, site conditions, usability, aesthetics, and regulations. Prepares drawings or models, coordinates with engineering teams, considers materials and sustainability, and follows registration requirements.
education: Recognized architecture education and registration/licensing as required

name: Interior Designer
description: Plans interior spaces to improve function, comfort, safety, and appearance. Selects layouts, finishes, colours, lighting, and furnishings while considering client needs, budgets, accessibility, and relevant building requirements.
education: Interior design education or portfolio-based route, subject to local rules

name: Mechanical Engineer
description: Designs, analyses, tests, or improves machines and mechanical systems. Applies mechanics, thermodynamics, materials knowledge, CAD, and testing methods to develop safe and effective products or equipment.
education: Recognized mechanical engineering degree

name: Electrical Engineer
description: Designs, tests, or maintains electrical and electronic systems, power equipment, or control systems. Analyses circuits, selects components, troubleshoots faults, and applies electrical standards and safety practices.
education: Recognized electrical/electronics engineering degree

name: Environmental Scientist
description: Studies environmental conditions and the effects of human activity on ecosystems, air, water, and soil. Collects samples or field data, analyses results, assesses impacts, and prepares reports that support environmental decisions.
education: Environmental science, biology, chemistry, or related education

name: Sustainability Consultant
description: Helps organisations measure and reduce environmental impacts while considering operational and business goals. Researches sustainability options, analyses energy or emissions data, supports reporting, and develops practical improvement plans.
education: Environmental science, engineering, business, or related education

name: Agricultural Scientist
description: Researches crops, soils, pests, farming systems, and agricultural productivity. Conducts trials or field observations, analyses results, and develops evidence-based practices to improve crop performance, resource use, and food systems.
education: Agriculture, agronomy, biology, or related education

name: Veterinarian
description: Diagnoses, treats, and helps prevent disease and injury in animals. Performs examinations, recommends treatment, advises owners on animal care, and follows veterinary ethics, biosecurity, and registration requirements.
education: Recognized veterinary degree and required registration

name: Veterinary Technician / Assistant
description: Supports veterinary teams with animal handling, routine care, preparation, observation, cleaning, and record keeping. Helps maintain a safe clinic or animal-care environment and performs only duties permitted by training and local rules.
education: Relevant animal-care training; local credential rules vary

name: Chef / Culinary Professional
description: Prepares food in professional kitchens and helps maintain quality, consistency, and food safety. Uses cooking techniques, plans or follows menus, manages ingredients and timing, and coordinates with kitchen staff.
education: Culinary training or apprenticeship; food-safety requirements apply

name: Hotel / Hospitality Manager
description: Oversees hotel or hospitality operations to deliver reliable guest service. Coordinates staff, rooms or service areas, budgets, supplies, quality standards, and responses to guest issues.
education: Hospitality, tourism, or business education; experience is valuable

name: Travel Consultant / Tourism Professional
description: Helps customers plan trips and travel experiences suited to their interests, budgets, and constraints. Researches destinations, prepares itineraries, coordinates bookings, explains travel information, and handles changes or service issues.
education: Tourism, hospitality, or related education; requirements vary

name: Event Planner
description: Organises events by turning a brief into a schedule, budget, supplier plan, and coordinated on-the-day delivery. Manages venues, vendors, logistics, communications, contingencies, and post-event review.
education: No single required degree; event experience and relevant training help

name: Photographer / Videographer
description: Creates still images or video for clients, publications, events, products, or storytelling. Plans shots, manages lighting and composition, captures footage, edits deliverables, and coordinates permissions and client expectations.
education: Formal training or portfolio-based route

name: Film / Video Editor
description: Shapes recorded footage into a coherent story or message. Selects and arranges clips, adjusts pacing, synchronises audio, performs basic colour and sound work, and collaborates with producers or directors.
education: Film, media, or self-directed portfolio route

name: Animator / 3D Artist
description: Creates animated sequences or digital 3D assets for films, games, advertising, visualisation, or other media. Develops models or drawings, applies movement and timing principles, renders work, and builds a demonstrable portfolio.
education: Animation, art, design, or portfolio-based route

name: Musician / Music Producer
description: Performs, composes, arranges, records, or produces music depending on their role. Develops musical technique, works with rhythm and theory, uses recording tools where relevant, and collaborates with performers or clients.
education: Formal music education or portfolio/apprenticeship route
skills: Instrument or Vocal Skills|Music Theory|Audio Production|Practice|Collaboration

name: Fitness Trainer
description: Helps clients work toward fitness goals through safe, structured exercise guidance. Assesses goals and readiness within their qualifications, plans sessions, teaches technique, monitors progress, and adapts activity to client needs.
education: Recognized fitness certification and first-aid training as required

name: Sports Coach
description: Develops athletes’ skills, tactics, fitness habits, and teamwork in a particular sport. Plans practices, observes performance, gives feedback, promotes safe participation, and supports development in line with coaching qualifications.
education: Sport-specific experience and coaching qualifications as required

name: Athlete / Sports Professional
description: Trains and competes in a sport while developing technical ability, conditioning, consistency, and performance strategy. Follows structured practice and recovery routines, reviews performance, and works with coaches and support staff.
education: Sport-specific development pathway; no single academic route

name: Fashion Designer
description: Develops clothing or accessory concepts and turns them into designs for production or individual clients. Researches trends and users, sketches ideas, selects fabrics, considers fit and construction, and refines designs through samples.
education: Fashion design education or portfolio/apprenticeship route

name: Fashion Merchandiser
description: Uses sales, inventory, customer, and trend information to help decide which fashion products to stock and how to present them. Supports buying, assortment planning, pricing, stock control, and performance analysis.
education: Fashion, retail, business, or merchandising education

name: Retail Store Manager
description: Runs daily store operations and supports sales, customer service, stock availability, and staff performance. Plans schedules, monitors sales and inventory, resolves customer issues, and maintains store standards.
education: No single required degree; retail experience and training help

name: Supply Chain / Logistics Coordinator
description: Coordinates the movement, storage, and availability of goods between suppliers, warehouses, carriers, and customers. Tracks orders and inventory, updates schedules, solves delivery problems, and uses operational data to improve reliability.
education: Supply chain, business, logistics, or related education

name: Public Policy Analyst
description: Researches public problems and evaluates possible government or institutional responses. Reviews evidence, legislation, budgets, and stakeholder views, compares policy options, and prepares clear briefings or recommendations.
education: Public policy, economics, political science, law, or related education

name: Civil Services / Public Administration
description: Supports public administration, policy implementation, and delivery of government services. Depending on the role and jurisdiction, work may involve examining issues, managing programmes, coordinating departments, and applying public rules fairly.
education: Eligibility and exams depend on the relevant public service

name: Urban Planner
description: Helps shape how towns and cities develop, including land use, transport, housing, public spaces, and services. Analyses maps and data, consults communities, evaluates proposals, and prepares plans within planning regulations.
education: Urban planning, geography, architecture, or related education

name: Librarian / Information Specialist
description: Organises information resources and helps people find reliable information. Manages catalogues or digital collections, supports research, teaches information skills, and helps maintain accessible information services.
education: Library/information science qualifications may be required

name: Museum / Heritage Professional
description: Helps preserve, document, interpret, or present cultural and historical collections or places. May research objects, maintain records, support exhibitions, engage visitors, and follow conservation and handling standards.
education: History, archaeology, museum studies, or related education

name: Archaeologist
description: Studies past human societies through material evidence, landscapes, and documented contexts. Conducts surveys or excavations, records finds carefully, analyses evidence, and prepares reports while following heritage and site-protection rules.
education: Archaeology, anthropology, history, or related education

name: Biologist
description: Studies living organisms and biological processes in laboratory, field, healthcare, conservation, or research settings. Collects and analyses evidence, uses appropriate scientific methods, records results, and communicates findings.
education: Biology or life-science education; advanced roles may require postgraduate study

name: Chemist
description: Investigates substances, their properties, and how they change through experiments or analytical testing. Prepares samples, uses laboratory instruments safely, interprets results, maintains records, and applies quality procedures.
education: Chemistry or chemical-science education

name: Physicist
description: Uses mathematical models and experiments to understand physical systems and phenomena. Depending on the specialisation, work may involve designing experiments, analysing measurements, simulating systems, developing technology, or conducting theoretical research.
education: Physics education; research roles commonly require postgraduate study

name: Statistician
description: Designs data collection and applies statistical methods to answer questions under uncertainty. Builds models, checks assumptions, interprets results, and explains what the data can and cannot support.
education: Statistics, mathematics, or quantitative education

name: Laboratory Technologist
description: Performs or supports laboratory tests and procedures in scientific, industrial, or healthcare settings. Prepares samples, operates instruments, follows quality and safety protocols, records results, and reports issues according to the role’s authorised scope.
education: Recognized lab-science qualification; healthcare roles may require registration

name: Emergency Medical Technician
description: Provides initial emergency medical assessment and care and supports safe patient transport. Recognises urgent conditions, follows approved protocols, communicates with dispatch and clinical teams, and works within certification and local scope-of-practice rules.
education: Recognized EMT training and certification/licensing as required

name: Community Health Worker
description: Connects people with health information, prevention services, and local care resources. Conducts outreach, explains health guidance in accessible ways, supports referrals, and maintains appropriate records while respecting confidentiality.
education: Relevant training; requirements depend on the health system

name: Nonprofit Program Coordinator
description: Coordinates activities for a nonprofit or community programme so work stays organised and aligned with its goals. Tracks schedules, budgets, partners, participation, and outcomes, and helps prepare updates for stakeholders.
education: Relevant education or community-sector experience

name: Fundraising / Development Officer
description: Builds support for an organisation’s mission through donor relationships, funding research, campaigns, and grant proposals. Communicates impact honestly, maintains donor records, and follows fundraising ethics and reporting requirements.
education: Communications, nonprofit management, business, or related experience

name: Career Counselor
description: Helps people explore education and work options in light of their interests, skills, circumstances, and goals. Provides career information, facilitates decision-making, supports job-search planning, and works within appropriate counseling and assessment boundaries.
education: Career counseling, psychology, education, or relevant credentials as required

name: Life Skills / Learning Coach
description: Helps clients set practical goals and build learning, organisation, communication, or everyday problem-solving habits. Uses structured conversations and progress reviews while keeping role boundaries clear and referring specialist needs when appropriate.
education: Relevant training and experience; scope should be clearly defined

name: Real Estate Agent
description: Helps clients buy, sell, rent, or lease property, depending on local licensing and the role. Markets listings, arranges viewings, explains transaction steps, negotiates offers, and manages documentation and client communication.
education: Local licensing or registration may be required

name: Sales Representative
description: Helps customers understand products or services and determines whether an offering fits their needs. Identifies prospects, explains value, answers questions, negotiates within approved terms, follows up, and records sales activity.
education: No single required degree; product knowledge and training matter

name: Customer Success Specialist
description: Helps customers adopt and get value from a product or service after purchase. Answers usage questions, monitors customer needs, coordinates issue resolution, shares product guidance, and works to improve retention and satisfaction.
education: Business, communications, or relevant customer-facing experience

name: Interpreter for Sign Language
description: Facilitates communication between sign-language users and people using spoken or other signed languages. Accurately conveys meaning and tone, follows confidentiality and impartiality standards, and works within relevant interpreting qualifications.
education: Sign-language proficiency and relevant training/credentials

name: Sign Language / Accessibility Advocate
description: Promotes communication access and inclusion for Deaf, disabled, or other underserved communities. Identifies access barriers, shares accessible practices, collaborates with affected communities, and supports improvements to services, information, or environments.
education: Relevant lived, professional, or advocacy experience; role-specific training helps

name: Mediator / Conflict Resolution Practitioner
description: Helps people in disagreement communicate and explore possible resolutions through a structured, impartial process. Clarifies issues, supports negotiation, manages discussions fairly, and follows applicable confidentiality and professional standards.
education: Relevant training and credentials may be required for specific settings

name: Religious / Community Organization Coordinator
description: Coordinates programmes, events, volunteers, or services for a religious or community organisation. Organises schedules and resources, communicates with participants, supports community needs, and handles sensitive information respectfully.
education: Role-specific community knowledge and relevant training

name: Dental Surgeon
description: Assesses and treats conditions affecting teeth, gums, and oral health within the scope of dental training and registration. Performs dental procedures, explains preventive care, maintains infection-control standards, and documents treatment.
education: Recognized dentistry degree and required registration

name: Speech-Language Therapist
description: Assesses and supports communication, speech, language, voice, fluency, or swallowing needs within professional scope. Develops individualised therapy plans, tracks progress, guides families or carers, and coordinates with other professionals.
education: Recognized speech-language pathology qualification; local registration may apply

name: Occupational Therapist
description: Helps people participate in daily activities despite injury, disability, illness, or other barriers. Assesses functional needs, adapts tasks or environments, recommends strategies or equipment, and reviews progress toward practical goals.
education: Recognized occupational therapy qualification and registration where required

name: Agricultural Extension Officer
description: Shares agricultural knowledge and support with farmers and rural communities. Demonstrates relevant farming practices, organises training or field visits, gathers feedback, and connects communities with technical or public services.
education: Agriculture or related education; public-sector requirements vary

name: Dairy Farm Manager
description: Oversees dairy farm operations, including animal welfare, feeding, milking routines, staff, records, and costs. Monitors herd health and production, follows hygiene and safety procedures, and coordinates farm resources.
education: Agriculture, animal science, or practical farm-management experience

name: Personal Financial Planner
description: Helps clients organise finances and plan for goals such as budgeting, saving, education, or retirement. Reviews financial circumstances, explains options and trade-offs, and provides advice only within applicable qualifications and licensing rules.
education: Finance-related training; certification or licensing may be required locally

name: Procurement Specialist
description: Helps an organisation source goods and services at appropriate cost, quality, and risk levels. Evaluates suppliers, compares quotations, supports contracts and purchase orders, tracks delivery, and maintains fair procurement records.
education: Supply chain, business, finance, or related education/experience

name: Makeup Artist
description: Applies makeup for clients, events, photography, performance, or other settings. Discusses the desired look, selects suitable products and techniques, maintains hygiene, considers skin sensitivities, and manages timing and client expectations.
education: Professional training or portfolio-based route; hygiene requirements apply

name: Carpenter / Woodworker
description: Builds, installs, repairs, or finishes wooden structures, furniture, and components. Measures and marks materials, reads plans, selects tools and joints, checks fit and finish, and follows workshop and site safety practices.
education: Apprenticeship, vocational training, or supervised practical experience

name: Electrician
description: Installs, inspects, maintains, or repairs electrical wiring and equipment within the limits of their training and licence. Reads diagrams, tests circuits, diagnoses faults, and follows electrical codes and strict safety procedures.
education: Recognized vocational training/apprenticeship and local licensing where required

name: Plumber
description: Installs, maintains, and repairs water supply, drainage, and related pipe systems. Diagnoses leaks or blockages, measures and fits components, tests work, and follows building, hygiene, and safety requirements.
education: Vocational training or apprenticeship; local licensing may apply
skills: Pipe Fitting|Leak Diagnosis|Tool Safety|Blueprint Reading|Customer Communication

name: Automotive Technician
description: Inspects, diagnoses, services, and repairs vehicles and their mechanical or electrical systems. Uses diagnostic equipment, follows service procedures, checks repairs, documents work, and applies workshop safety practices.
education: Vocational automotive training or apprenticeship

name: Renewable Energy Technician
description: Installs, inspects, maintains, or troubleshoots renewable-energy equipment such as solar systems, subject to training and authorisation. Checks components and connections, follows electrical and working-at-height safety procedures, and records maintenance.
education: Technical/vocational training in electrical or renewable energy systems

name: Paramedic
description: Provides advanced pre-hospital emergency assessment and care within the authorised scope of practice. Manages urgent situations using approved protocols, coordinates with emergency teams, monitors patients during transport, and documents care.
education: Recognized paramedic training and certification/licensing as required
skills: Emergency Assessment|First Aid|Patient Transport|Calm Decision Making|Communication

name: Speech and Debate Coach
description: Trains learners to research arguments, structure speeches, present clearly, and respond thoughtfully to opposing views. Plans practice sessions, teaches evidence use and delivery, gives constructive feedback, and supports ethical competition.
education: Relevant subject knowledge and coaching experience; requirements vary

name: Translator for Local Languages
description: Translates written content involving local or regional languages while preserving meaning, context, and cultural references. Researches terminology, checks accuracy with reliable sources or speakers when needed, and protects confidential information.
education: Strong proficiency in relevant languages; specialist training may help

name: Agricultural Entrepreneur
description: Builds a business around farming, agricultural services, processing, or related products. Combines practical agricultural knowledge with customer research, cost planning, production decisions, sales, and compliance with relevant rules.
education: No single required degree; practical agriculture and business knowledge help

name: Bakery / Pastry Professional
description: Produces breads, cakes, pastries, desserts, or other baked goods using precise recipes and production methods. Measures ingredients, manages proofing and baking, maintains food hygiene, controls waste, and presents products consistently.
education: Culinary training, apprenticeship, or supervised experience; food-safety rules apply

name: Personal Trainer for Older Adults
description: Supports older adults in pursuing strength, balance, mobility, and general fitness goals with age-aware exercise planning. Screens for relevant limitations within their qualifications, adapts movements safely, tracks progress, and refers medical concerns to qualified professionals.
education: Recognized fitness certification and relevant safety/first-aid training

name: Community Arts Coordinator
description: Organises arts activities, workshops, exhibitions, or performances that engage a community. Coordinates artists, venues, schedules, budgets, partners, and participants, while aiming to make activities welcoming and accessible.
education: Arts, education, or community experience; role requirements vary
